title: Naruto Shinobi Origins
description: Naruto Shinobi Origins is a Modpack based on the Anime/Manga "Naruto" by Masashi Kishimoto.
body:
![Naruto Shinobi Origins Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Naruto_Shinobi_Origins/MP_NarutoShinobiOrigins_header.webp)
[![Naruto Shinobi Origins Bisecthosting](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Naruto_Shinobi_Origins/MP_NarutoShinobiOrigins_promo.webp)](https://tinyurl.com/amy67484)
![Naruto Shinobi Origins Overview](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Naruto_Shinobi_Origins/MP_NarutoShinobiOrigins_overview.webp)
---
**Naruto Shinobi Origins** is a fantasy themed Modpack based on the anime/manga "Naruto". Unleash your chakra and master your dreams of becoming a shinobi or perhaps the art of ninjutsu instead. Spawn in and make your own custom Naruto character, join a hidden village and master jutsu, roam across the lands fighting bosses and powerful enemies. Power or peace what will your path be...

---
![Naruto Shinobi Origins Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Naruto_Shinobi_Origins/MP_NarutoShinobiOrigins_features.webp)
---
- [⚔️] **Ninshu Origins** - Bring the world of Naruto into Minecraft. Bosses, enemies, weapons, jutsu and more.
- [🥏] **Performance** - The Modpack has been fully optimised for both low and high end systems, don't miss out on shader usage, shader away!

---
